newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close barely higher in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close barely higher in heavy trading.

text.p: French stocks closed barely higher after briefly touching a new year high on Thursday in a day of very heavy trading which saw frenetic action in shares of insurers UAP and Axa.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 0.99 points or 0.04 percent at 2218.18 while the CAC-40 futures contract closed at 2,226.0. Earlier The CAC-40 index peaked at 2,233.81.
Volume was an extremely heavy 9.9 billion francs.
* Shares in UAP and Axa were the centre of attention as they requoted for the first time since announcing on Tuesday they planned to merge to create the world's second biggest insurer.
*UAP, which closed 16.34 percent higher at 136 francs, was the biggest gainer and saw trading volume of 15.9 million shares, much higher than any other stock in the market.
*Axa closed down 3.77 percent at 306.5 francs on volume of 4.7 million shares as investors anticipated a dilution in share value as a result of the terms of the merger.

*Sligos was the second-biggest gainer, up 14.88 percent to 633 francs, as it requoted for the first time since Axime said it would bid for Sligos. Axime, also requoting for the first time since the bid announcement, closed up 4.90 percent at 557 francs.
*Lafarge closed up 4.58 percent at 314.8 francs after posting improved nine month sales on Wednesday. Volume was 425,936 shares.

* Vallourec closed 3.61 percent higher on persistent rumours, denied last week, that major shareholder Usinor might be about to sell its 28 percent capital stake in the company. "Vallourec is not for sale," the company's managing director Jean-Claude Verdiere said on November 6.
* Pechiney biggest loser on the day, down 5.95 percent at 208.8 francs after predicting a second half 1996 net loss. Volume was 189,399 shares.

* Sanofi ended lower as investors took profits after a run-up in recent days. The stock rose on anticipation, confirmed on Wednesday, that its clopidogrel heart drug worked better than aspirin in preventing stroke, heart attack or death in patients with cardiovascular problems.
* The SBF stock markets' association said the 9.9 billion franc volume was the biggest since May 23, when volume was 10.2 billion francs.
